faqs.q: How long does a typical automation take to build?
faqs.a: Most single-workflow projects take one to two weeks from signed proposal to handover. Larger, multi-system integrations can take longer — you'll get a specific timeline in your written proposal, not a vague estimate.

faqs.q: Do I need any technical knowledge?
faqs.a: No. You don't need to know anything about n8n, APIs, or code. We handle the technical build entirely and walk you through how to use and monitor your automation in plain language during handover.

faqs.q: What if something breaks after handover?
faqs.a: Every project includes a short warranty window after handover for us to fix anything that isn't working as scoped. After that, our optional monthly support plan keeps things monitored and maintained long-term.

faqs.q: What tools do you typically work with?
faqs.a: We build primarily in n8n and connect it to whatever you already use — common examples include CRMs, Google Sheets, Airtable, Slack, email platforms, and AI tools like OpenAI and Claude. If you use something specific, ask us on the discovery call.

caseStudies.title: Lead Qualification Automation for a Local Real Estate Agency
caseStudies.desc: Leads from the website, Facebook ads, and referrals had to be manually reviewed before agents could follow up — causing delays and dropped leads.
caseStudies.result: Saved an estimated 8+ hours per week on manual lead sorting.
caseStudies.problem: New leads arrived from the agency's website form, Facebook ad campaigns, and referral partners — each landing in a different inbox or spreadsheet. Agents had to manually check every source, judge lead quality, and decide who to assign it to, often hours after the lead first came in. By the time follow-up happened, some prospects had already gone with a competitor.
caseStudies.automation: We built an n8n workflow that watches all three lead sources in real time. As soon as a lead comes in, it's automatically enriched with basic contact and property-interest data, scored for quality using an AI step, and routed straight into the right agent's CRM pipeline. A Slack notification alerts the agent instantly, with the lead's score and summary attached.
caseStudies.resultFull: Saved an estimated 8+ hours per week previously spent on manual lead sorting and follow-up.

caseStudies.title: Automated Client Onboarding for a Marketing Agency
caseStudies.desc: Onboarding a new client meant manually creating folders, sending welcome emails, and updating spreadsheets across multiple tools.
caseStudies.result: Cut onboarding time per client from ~3 hours to under 15 minutes.
caseStudies.problem: Every new signed client meant the same manual checklist: create a shared folder, send a welcome email, schedule the kickoff call, and update both the CRM and the internal project tracker. It was repetitive, easy to forget a step on, and pulled time away from actual client work.
caseStudies.automation: We built a single n8n workflow triggered the moment a contract is marked as signed. It automatically creates the client's folder structure, sends a personalized welcome email, finds a kickoff call slot and sends the invite, then updates the CRM record and project tracker — all without anyone touching a spreadsheet.
caseStudies.resultFull: Cut onboarding time per new client from roughly 3 hours down to under 15 minutes.

caseStudies.title: Inventory & Order Sync for an E-commerce Store
caseStudies.desc: Stock levels lived in three disconnected places, so counts were constantly out of date and items oversold.
caseStudies.result: Reduced overselling incidents by an estimated 90% in month one.
caseStudies.problem: Stock levels lived in three disconnected places: the Shopify store, an internal spreadsheet, and manual email updates from the supplier. Reconciling them by hand meant stock counts were frequently out of date, leading to overselling items that were actually out of stock and delays getting accurate fulfillment information to customers.
caseStudies.automation: We connected Shopify, the supplier's inventory feed, and the internal spreadsheet into a single automated sync in n8n. Stock levels and order statuses now update in real time across every system, and the workflow automatically sends a low-stock alert to the team before an item actually runs out.
caseStudies.resultFull: Reduced overselling incidents by an estimated 90% within the first month.
